name: band horizontal biceps curl
description: A band curl done with the band pulling horizontally, which keeps constant tension on your biceps through the whole range.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and face away from the anchor, holding the ends.
Step out until the band is taut and raise your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your hands toward your head.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly extend your arms again.
Keep your elbows level with your shoulders the whole time.
